ተወልዱ: ተወልደ — they were born (3mp perfect, passive/reflexive of ወለደ)
ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)
ም: ዓለም — the closing letter of ዓለም (ለዓለ ም 'for ever'), split off by a print break (not a word)
ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — woman, wife (noun, fem., construct / accusative)
ወአውሰበ: አውሰበ — and he married (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሰበ; of a man taking a wife)
ወሞተ: ሞተ — and he died (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-w-t)
ወወለደ: ወለደ — and he begot (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-l-d)
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55) · ለ — after ያፈቅር, 'he loves her, is fond of her' (ያፈቅር ላቲ; ለ- marking the object, with -ቲ '3fs')
በሕገ: ሕግ — by the law of (በ- + noun, construct)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
በበ: በበ — each, every, by (distributive, doubled preposition በ-)
